sections.description:
Need a clean way to show social profile links on your website? This plugin helps you display a social media icon list anywhere. Add icons to your sidebar, footer, or posts.

This tool is simple and fast. It works with any WordPress theme.

You can configure each social media icon in seconds. Control colors, padding, and hover actions without code. It includes an optimized Gutenberg block and sidebar widget.

View Premium Demo: Social Media Icon Widget Premium
More About Pro: Social Media Icon Widget Premium Features

Video Tutorial

Set up Social Icons and Social Profile Links

Showing your social icons should be easy. This plugin saves you time:

  • Simple drag and drop: Place the widget in any sidebar area.
  • Gutenberg block support: Insert social profile links directly into page layouts.
  • SVG Icons: Light SVG renders sharp on all screens.
  • Responsive Grid: Icons adjust automatically to fit mobile devices.

Gutenberg Block and Widget Customization

Customize your social media icon styling to match your brand style:

  • Set custom colors for icon designs and backgrounds.

Supported Platforms

  • Pinterest, LinkedIn, Snapchat, TikTok

You can adjust each social media icon color to match your brand, add hover effects for visual feedback, and even apply rotation transforms for a unique touch. The spacing controls help you create the exact layout you want.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/new-social-media-widget/ folder. Or search for it in your WordPress admin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Appearance > Widgets in your admin dashboard.
  4. Drag the widget to your sidebar area.
  5. Alternatively, open a page and insert the Gutenberg block.
  6. Paste your social profile links and save.
sections.faq:
How do I configure my social media icon list?

Go to Appearance > Widgets in your admin panel. Add the widget to a sidebar. You can also edit pages and add the Gutenberg block. Paste your social profile links into the fields.

Can I use a Gutenberg block to display social icons?

Yes. Search for the “Social Media Widget” block in the editor. Add it to any page. Customize the social profile links inside the block settings.

Can I change the style of my social profile links?

Yes. The settings let you choose custom colors. You can set icon background colors and apply hover effects.

Which social icons are included?

The free plugin supports 12 major networks. This includes Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, X, and WhatsApp.

Do these social profile links open in a new tab?

Yes. You can select if links open in a new tab or the same window.
